sentences.text: Paattikiiltoon Oy is a company registered on 2026-08-20 under the industry code 33150, repair and maintenance of civilian ships and boats.
First sales are recorded on 2026-08-20, and a start-up notification and a board change were registered on 2026-08-24.
No grant, EU project, public contract or funding record is on file.
For the fund this is a watchlist case: the registered industry is on the thesis list, but a new boat care firm shows no technology or growth evidence yet.
